mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.task_id, b.batch_no, b.device_count, b.dispatched_count, b.success_count, b.failed_count, b.skipped_count, b.status, b.scheduled_at, b.started_at, b.finished_at, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM ota_upgrade_batch b JOIN ota_upgrade_task t ON t.id = b.task_id WHERE b.status = 'PENDING' AND t.status = 'RUNNING' AND t.batch_mode = 'BATCHED' AND t.batch_interval_ms > 0 AND b.batch_no = t.current_batch_no + 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ota_upgrade_record r WHERE r.task_id = b.task_id AND r.batch_no = b.batch_no - 1 AND r.status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'DOWNLOADING', 'FLASHING', 'VERIFYING') ) AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(r2.updated_at) FROM ota_upgrade_record r2 WHERE r2.task_id = b.task_id AND r2.batch_no = b.batch_no - 1), b.created_at), #{now}) >= #{batchIntervalMs} * 1000 ORDER BY b.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ota_upgrade_batch b JOIN ( SELECT r.task_id AS task_id, r.batch_no AS batch_no, COUNT(*) AS device_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status <> 'PENDING' AND r.status <> 'SKIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dispatched_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('FAILED', 'TIMEOUT') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SKIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS skipped_count, CASE WHEN b.status = 'SKIPPED' THEN 'SKIPPED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN r.status IN ('PENDING', 'DISPATCHED', 'DOWNLOADING', 'FLASHING', 'VERIFYING') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END AS status FROM ota_upgrade_record r WHERE r.task_id = #{taskId} AND r.batch_no = #{batchNo} GROUP BY r.task_id, r.batch_no ) agg ON b.task_id = agg.task_id AND b.batch_no = agg.batch_no SET b.device_count = agg.device_count, b.dispatched_count = agg.dispatched_count, b.success_count = agg.success_count, b.failed_count = agg.failed_count, b.skipped_count = agg.skipped_count, b.status = agg.status, b.finished_at = CASE WHEN b.finished_at IS NOT NULL THEN b.finished_at WHEN agg.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) ELSE b.finished_at END, b.updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE b.task_id = #{taskId} AND b.batch_no = #{batchNo}
